rows.corpus_definition: Including all the necessary parts or details.
rows.example_en: The report provides a comprehensive guide to the project.

rows.corpus_definition: to keep something hidden so that nobody can see it
rows.example_en: He tried to conceal his fear from them.

rows.corpus_definition: To admit that something is true after first denying it.
rows.example_en: He had to concede that he was wrong.

rows.corpus_definition: To express strong public disapproval of something or someone.
rows.example_en: The leaders chose to condemn the recent violence.

rows.corpus_definition: Made shorter or thicker by removing water.
rows.example_en: We added condensed milk to make the dessert sweet.

rows.corpus_definition: To keep someone or something within certain limits.
rows.example_en: They must confine their dogs to the yard.

rows.corpus_definition: To face someone in a difficult or angry situation.
rows.example_en: She decided to confront him about his lies.

rows.corpus_definition: The part of your mind that tells you what is right.
rows.example_en: My conscience feels clear after helping my friend.

rows.corpus_definition: To give permission for something to happen.
rows.example_en: They need your consent to start building.

rows.corpus_definition: Happening as a result of something else.
rows.example_en: Heavy rain and consequent flooding destroyed the town.
